mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, sustained for 2 months, indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A steady federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% for 3 months signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200k in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS growth > 200k in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 3% YoY, sustained for 2 quarters, indicates a supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in supply-driven growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% QoQ, accompanied by a > 5% MoM increase in retail sales (RSAFS), signals a demand surge, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 3% QoQ and RSAFS growth > 5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A > 50bps increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within 2 months signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to < 50k in the same month, it signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.5% and PAYEMS growth < 50k in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth below -2% YoY, sustained for 1 quarter, indicates a supply-side contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in supply-driven downturn periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
